		PanelPad = 8, FieldPad = 8, GroupBodyTop = 4, GroupGap = 4, OpenGroupGap = 8, TypeGap = 8,
		Corner = 6, BigCorner = 10,
		Swatch = 16, ToggleWidth = 28, ToggleHeight = 16, Knob = 12, AxisPill = 20, IconSlot = 20,
	},
	[16] = {
		Text = 16, TitleText = 20, TypeText = 20, GroupText = 16,
		TitleBar = 32, Search = 28, TypeHead = 32, GroupHead = 28,
		Row = 28, RowGap = 4, RowIndent = 0, LabelWidth = 96, LabelGap = 8,
		PanelPad = 8, FieldPad = 8, GroupBodyTop = 4, GroupGap = 4, OpenGroupGap = 8, TypeGap = 8,
		Corner = 6, BigCorner = 10,
		Swatch = 20, ToggleWidth = 36, ToggleHeight = 20, Knob = 16, AxisPill = 20, IconSlot = 20,
	},
}

-- Contrast floors against the surfaces each role sits on.
local FLOOR = {
	Primary = 12,
	Label = 7,
	Secondary = 5.5,
	Heading = 4.5,
	Disabled = 3.2,
	Control = 3.1,
	Accent = 3.1,
	Subtle = 1.6,
}

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- A saved field colour is kept only when it stands apart from the panel on the readable side.
local function resolveField(inputs, light, ColorMath)
	local field = inputs.field
	local panel = inputs.panel
	local wrongSide = (not light) and ColorMath.luminance(field) < ColorMath.luminance(panel)
	if ColorMath.contrast(field, panel) >= 1.2 and not wrongSide then
		return field
	end
	local hue, saturation = panel:ToHSV()
	return ColorMath.solveTone(hue, saturation * 0.9, { panel }, 1.25, light)
end

-- Heading hue comes from the text colour when it has colour, otherwise from the accent.
local function resolveHeading(inputs, surfaces, light, ColorMath)
	local _, textChroma = ColorMath.toOklch(inputs.text)
	local source = textChroma >= 0.04 and inputs.text or inputs.accent
	local _, chroma, hue = ColorMath.toOklch(source)
	local lightness = light and 0.45 or 0.80
	return ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(lightness, math.min(chroma, 0.12), hue, surfaces, FLOOR.Heading, light)
end

function Typo.derive(inputs, ColorMath)
	local panel = inputs.panel
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(panel)
	local field = resolveField(inputs, light, ColorMath)
	local header = ColorMath.mix(panel, field, 0.5)
	local surfaces = { panel, field, header }

	local textHue, textSaturation = inputs.text:ToHSV()
	local accentHue, accentSaturation = inputs.accent:ToHSV()

	local primary = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.25, surfaces, FLOOR.Primary, light)
	local secondary = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.55, surfaces, FLOOR.Secondary, light)
	local disabled = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.45, surfaces, FLOOR.Disabled, light)
	local label = ColorMath.backOff(primary, panel, 0.28, FLOOR.Label, { panel })
	local heading = resolveHeading(inputs, { panel, header }, light, ColorMath)

	local borderControl = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, math.min(accentSaturation * 0.6, 0.45), { panel, header }, FLOOR.Control, light)
	local borderSubtle = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, math.min(accentSaturation * 0.5, 0.35), { panel }, FLOOR.Subtle, light)

	local accent = inputs.accent
	if ColorMath.minContrast(accent, { panel, field }) < FLOOR.Accent then
		accent = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, accentSaturation, { panel, field }, FLOOR.Accent, light)
	end
	local onAccent = panel
	if ColorMath.contrast(panel, accent) < 4.5 then
		onAccent = ColorMath.contrast(BLACK, accent) > ColorMath.contrast(WHITE, accent) and BLACK or WHITE
	end

	local knobOn = panel
	if ColorMath.contrast(panel, heading) < 3 then
		knobOn = ColorMath.contrast(BLACK, heading) > ColorMath.contrast(WHITE, heading) and BLACK or WHITE
	end
	-- The focus ring sits on the field, where the heading hue can be too close.
	local focus = heading
	if ColorMath.contrast(focus, field) < 3 then
		focus = primary
	end

	return {
		Panel = panel,
		Header = header,
		Band = panel,
		Field = field,
		FieldHover = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.08),
		Selected = ColorMath.mix(field, accent, 0.28),
		Sunken = ColorMath.mix(panel, BLACK, light and 0.08 or 0.35),
		TextPrimary = primary,
		TextHeading = heading,
		TextLabel = label,
		TextSecondary = secondary,
		TextDisabled = disabled,
		Outline = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.12),
		OutlineHover = borderControl,
		Focus = focus,
		Divider = borderSubtle,
		Rule = borderSubtle,
		PanelStroke = borderSubtle,
		Accent = accent,
		OnAccent = onAccent,
		ToggleOn = heading,
		ToggleOff = field,
		KnobOn = knobOn,
		KnobOff = secondary,
	}
end

return Typo

--[[
	ThemeStore  -  the saved theme as text: the ThemeJSON plugin setting and the theme code box.
	  ThemeStore.decode(json)            the values present in a theme code, or nil if unreadable.
	  ThemeStore.encode()                the current theme in T as a theme code.
	  ThemeStore.load(json)              writes a saved theme into T and refreshes; used before Build.
	  ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(text)  "123" -> "rbxassetid://123".
	Colours are hex strings; panelAlpha and blobAlpha are percentages (the Classic mode's
	see-through). A fontSize from an older code is dropped, and a code without a mode gets the
	default mode.
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local ThemeModes = require(script.Parent.ThemeModes)
local T = C.T

local ThemeStore = {}

-- Version written into new theme codes.
local FORMAT_VERSION = 3

local COLOR_KEYS = { "accent", "bg", "blob", "slider", "scrollBar", "textAccent" }

function ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(text)
	text = (text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if text == "" then
		return ""
	end
	if text:match("^%d+$") then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. text
	end
	return text
end

function ThemeStore.decode(json)
	if type(json) ~= "string" or json == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(json)
	end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	local theme = {}
	for _, key in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
		if type(data[key]) == "string" then
			theme[key] = C.hexToColor3(data[key])
		end
	end
	if type(data.font) == "string" then
		theme.font = data.font
	end
	if type(data.bgImage) == "string" then
		theme.bgImage = ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(data.bgImage)
	end
	if type(data.bgImageAlpha) == "number" then
		theme.bgImageTransparency = math.clamp(data.bgImageAlpha / 100, 0, 1)
	end
	if type(data.panelAlpha) == "number" then
		theme.panelAlpha = math.clamp(data.panelAlpha / 100, 0, 1)
	end
	if type(data.blobAlpha) == "number" then
		theme.blobAlpha = math.clamp(data.blobAlpha / 100, 0, 1)
	end
	if type(data.mode) == "string" then
		theme.mode = ThemeModes.get(data.mode).Id
	end
	if type(data.textSize) == "number" then
		theme.textSize = ThemeModes.textSize(data.textSize)
	end
	return theme
end

function ThemeStore.encode()
	return HttpService:JSONEncode({
		v = FORMAT_VERSION,
		mode = T.Mode,
		textSize = T.TextSize,
		accent = C.color3ToHex(T.InputAccent),
		bg = C.color3ToHex(T.InputBg),
		blob = C.color3ToHex(T.InputBlob),
		slider = C.color3ToHex(T.InputSlider),
		scrollBar = C.color3ToHex(T.InputScrollBar),
		textAccent = C.color3ToHex(T.TextAccent),
		panelAlpha = math.floor(T.InputPanelAlpha * 100 + 0.5),
		blobAlpha = math.floor(T.InputBlobAlpha * 100 + 0.5),
		font = T.Font.Name,
		bgImage = T.BgImage or "",
		bgImageAlpha = math.floor((T.BgImageTransparency or 1) * 100 + 0.5),
	})
end

-- Mutates T (the shared theme table). Runs before Build, so nothing needs repainting.
function ThemeStore.load(json)
	local theme = ThemeStore.decode(json)
	if not theme then
		return false
	end
	T.InputAccent = theme.accent or T.InputAccent
	T.InputBg = theme.bg or T.InputBg
	T.InputBlob = theme.blob or T.InputBlob
	T.InputSlider = theme.slider or T.InputSlider
	T.InputScrollBar = theme.scrollBar or T.InputScrollBar
	T.TextAccent = theme.textAccent or T.TextAccent
	T.BgImage = theme.bgImage or T.BgImage
	T.BgImageTransparency = theme.bgImageTransparency or T.BgImageTransparency
	T.InputPanelAlpha = theme.panelAlpha or T.InputPanelAlpha
	T.InputBlobAlpha = theme.blobAlpha or T.InputBlobAlpha
	T.Mode = theme.mode or ThemeModes.DEFAULT
	T.TextSize = theme.textSize or ThemeModes.DEFAULT_TEXT_SIZE
	if theme.font then
		local ok, font = pcall(function()
			return Enum.Font[theme.font]
		end)
		if ok and font then
			T.Font = font
		end
	end
	C.refresh()
	return true
end

return ThemeStore

-- ToolDecks  -  Part-Icles V5. Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
-- The two tool decks (WidgetDeck): "Re:" holds the Size and Time pages (Resize / Retime), "PropertyTools"
-- holds Clipboard and Shifter. Page refs keep their old names (ResizePanel is the Size page and so on),
-- so QOLWiring, SelectionHandler and Actions see the same frames as before. Either deck can be split
-- into one panel per page from its header (DeckSplit). Sizes and page content come from the current
-- mode's builders (ToolPanels.builders()).

local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local TP = require(script.Parent.ToolPanels)

local ToolDecks = {}

local function merge(into, refs)
	for key, value in pairs(refs) do into[key] = value end
end

function ToolDecks.build(sg, TypeRegistry)
	local refs = {}
	local builders = TP.builders()
	local layout = builders.deckLayout()

	local re = W.makeDeck(sg, {
		name = "ReDeck", title = "Re:", titleWidth = 20, trayTitle = "Re: Size/Time", width = layout.ReWidth, minWidth = layout.ReMinWidth,
		pages = {
			{ key = "Size", label = "Size", height = layout.Size },
			{ key = "Time", label = "Time", height = layout.Time },
		},
	})
	merge(refs, builders.buildResize(re.Pages.Size))
	merge(refs, builders.buildRetime(re.Pages.Time))
	refs.ReDeck = re.Frame
	refs.ReDeckApi = re.api
	refs.ReDeckSolos = re.Solos

	local props = W.makeDeck(sg, {
		name = "PropertyToolsDeck", trayTitle = "PropertyTools", width = layout.ToolsWidth, minWidth = layout.ToolsMinWidth,
		pages = {
			{ key = "Clipboard", label = "Clipboard", height = layout.Clipboard },
			{ key = "Shifter", label = "Shifter", height = layout.Shifter },
		},
	})
	merge(refs, builders.buildClipboard(props.Pages.Clipboard, TypeRegistry))
	merge(refs, builders.buildShifter(props.Pages.Shifter, TypeRegistry))
	refs.PropertyToolsDeck = props.Frame
	refs.PropertyToolsDeckApi = props.api
	refs.PropertyToolsDeckSolos = props.Solos

	return refs
end

return ToolDecks

--[[

]]

--[[
	DeckPages  -  the tool deck pages (Resize, Retime, Clipboard, Shifter) laid out for the theme
	modes other than Classic. Each builder fills the page frame WidgetDeck hands in (the area under
	the deck's title bar) and returns the refs its Classic counterpart in ToolPanels returns.
	DeckPages.deckLayout() gives the deck widths and page heights these layouts need.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local ToolPanels = require(script.Parent.Parent.ToolPanels)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local DeckPages = {}

-- W.makeSlider's fixed height.
local SLIDER_HEIGHT = 28

-- Height of a deck whose page stacks `rows` rows plus `extra` pixels of other content.
local function deckHeight(rows, extra)
	local gaps = math.max(rows - 1, 0) * LAYOUT.RowGap
	return LAYOUT.TitleBar + LAYOUT.PanelPad * 2 + rows * LAYOUT.Row + gaps + extra
end

function DeckPages.deckLayout()
	local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
	local sliderBlock = SLIDER_HEIGHT + LAYOUT.RowGap
	return {
		ReWidth = sizes.ReDeck,
		ReMinWidth = sizes.ReDeckMin,
		ToolsWidth = sizes.PropertyToolsDeck,
		ToolsMinWidth = sizes.ReDeck,
		Size = deckHeight(3, sliderBlock),
		Time = deckHeight(2, sliderBlock),
		Clipboard = sizes.PropertyToolsHeight,
		Shifter = sizes.PropertyToolsHeight,
	}
end

-- A multiplier slider and the page's switches under it, with Apply / Reset held at the page's
-- bottom edge: a panel dragged shorter than its rows gives up the switches and keeps the buttons.
local function buildScalePage(page, switches)
	local rows = Instance.new("Frame")
	rows.Name = "Rows"
	rows.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rows.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap))
	rows.ClipsDescendants = true
	rows.Parent = page
	W.addListLayout(rows, LAYOUT.RowGap)

	local slider, input, setValue, getValue = W.makeSlider(rows, 0.5, 2, 1, nil, "%.2fx", true)
	slider.LayoutOrder = 0

	local toggles = {}
	for index, switch in ipairs(switches) do
		toggles[index] = W.makeSwitchRow(rows, switch.name, switch.label, index)
	end

	local buttons, buttonRow = W.makeButtonRow(page, "Buttons", {
		{ name = "Ap", text = "Apply" },
		{ name = "Rs", text = "Reset", role = "TextSecondary" },
	}, 0)
	buttonRow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	buttonRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)

	return {
		slider = slider, input = input, setValue = setValue, getValue = getValue,
		toggles = toggles, apply = buttons[1], reset = buttons[2],
	}
end

function DeckPages.buildResize(page)
	local parts = buildScalePage(page, {
		{ name = "ResDesc", label = "Include Descendants" },
		{ name = "ResShape", label = "Scale Spawn Area" },
	})
	-- A container is nearly always resized together with what is inside it.
	parts.toggles[1]:SetAttribute("IsOn", true)
	return {
		ResizeGetVal = parts.getValue, ResizeSetVal = parts.setValue, ResizeInput = parts.input,
		ResizeDescToggle = parts.toggles[1], ResizeScaleShapeToggle = parts.toggles[2],
		ResizeApply = parts.apply, ResizeReset = parts.reset,
		ResizeSlider = parts.slider, ResizePanel = page,
	}
end

function DeckPages.buildRetime(page)
	local parts = buildScalePage(page, {
		{ name = "RetDesc", label = "Include Descendants" },
	})
	parts.toggles[1]:SetAttribute("IsOn", true)
	return {
		RetimeGetVal = parts.getValue, RetimeSetVal = parts.setValue, RetimeInput = parts.input,
		RetimeDescToggle = parts.toggles[1],
		RetimeApply = parts.apply, RetimeReset = parts.reset,
		RetimeSlider = parts.slider, RetimePanel = page,
	}
end

-- The scrolling property list that fills a page from `top` down.
local function makeList(page, top)
	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = "Scroll"
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
	scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -top)
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scroll.Parent = page
	W.addListLayout(scroll, 2)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, scroll)
	return scroll
end

function DeckPages.buildClipboard(page, TypeRegistry)
	local buttons = W.makeButtonRow(page, "Buttons", {
		{ name = "Cp", text = "Copy" },
		{ name = "Ps", text = "Paste" },
	}, 0)

	local top = LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap
	local search, searchField = W.makeSearchField(page, "Search", "Search...")
	searchField.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)

	local scroll = makeList(page, top + LAYOUT.Search + LAYOUT.RowGap)
	ToolPanels.fillClipboardList(scroll, search, TypeRegistry)
	return {
		ClipCopy = buttons[1], ClipPaste = buttons[2], ClipSearch = search,
		ClipboardPanel = page, ClipboardScroll = scroll,
	}
end

function DeckPages.buildShifter(page, TypeRegistry)
	local step = LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap

	local input = W.makeTextField(page, "Shift", "1.0", Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

	local operations, operationRow = W.makeButtonRow(page, "Operations", {
		{ name = "Mul", text = "x" },
		{ name = "Div", text = "/" },
		{ name = "Add", text = "+" },
		{ name = "Sub", text = "-" },
	}, 0)
	operationRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, step)

	local envelope, envelopeRow = W.makeSwitchRow(page, "Env", "Scale Envelope", 0)
	envelopeRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, step * 2)

	local search, searchField = W.makeSearchField(page, "Search", "Search...")
	searchField.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, step * 3)

	local scroll = makeList(page, step * 3 + LAYOUT.Search + LAYOUT.RowGap)
	ToolPanels.fillShifterList(scroll, search, TypeRegistry)
	return {
		ShiftInput = input,
		ShiftMul = operations[1], ShiftDiv = operations[2], ShiftAdd = operations[3], ShiftSub = operations[4],
		EnvelopeToggle = envelope, ShiftSearch = search,
		ShifterPanel = page, ShifterScroll = scroll,
	}
end

return DeckPages

--[[

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)

local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Between the three value fields of the Hue panel.
local READOUT_GAP = 4

local Panels = {}

-- Tools menu entries in order: the ref name wiring looks up, and the button text.

function Panels.buildQMenu(sg)
	local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
	local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
	local rowCount = #TOOL_BUTTONS + 1
	local height = LAYOUT.TitleBar + pad * 2 + rowCount * LAYOUT.Row + (rowCount - 1) * LAYOUT.RowGap

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "QMenu"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	-- Bottom-right, left of the Settings panel so both can be open at their default places.
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(sizes.Settings + 32), 1, -(PanelSizes.bottomBarTop() + 6))
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizes.Tools, 0, height)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true
	panel.Active = true
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = sg
	W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner)
	W.addStroke(panel)
	W.addPadding(panel, pad, pad, pad, pad)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)

	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, "Tools", 0)

	bar.title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot * 2, 1, 0)

		panel.Visible = false

	refs.OptToggle = W.makeSwitchRow(list, "Q_Opt", "Opt. Indicator", rowCount)

	W.addCollapseButton(bar.header, { list }, {
		panel = panel,
		expandedSize = UDim2.new(0, sizes.Tools, 0, height),
		collapsedSize = UDim2.new(0, sizes.Tools, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar),
		arrowPos = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 0, 0),
	})

	refs.QMenu = panel
	refs.QMenuClose = bar.close
	return refs
end

function Panels.buildHueChanger(sg)
	local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
	local panel, chrome = W.makeToolShell(sg, "HueChanger", sizes.Hue, sizes.HueHeight)
	chrome.title.Text = "Hue"
	panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", "Hue")
	local body = chrome.body
	local refs = {}

	-- Under the tracks: one line of letters, the values (degrees, percent, percent), then
	-- Apply / Reset.
	local letterHeight = LAYOUT.Text + 4
	local readoutHeight = LAYOUT.Row - 4
	local buttonBlock = LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap
	local readoutBlock = buttonBlock + readoutHeight + LAYOUT.RowGap

	-- A value field: what its slider is set to, and a place to type an exact value.
	local function makeReadout(index, xScale)
		local field = W.makeBlob("Value" .. index, body, UDim2.new(1 / 3, -READOUT_GAP, 0, readoutHeight))
		field.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		field.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 1, -buttonBlock)

		local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
		box.Name = "Box"
		box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		box.Text = "0"
		box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(box, "Caption")
		W.paint(box, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
		box.Parent = field
		W.wireFieldStates(field, box)
		return box
	end
	ToolPanels.buildHueSliders(body, refs, letterHeight + readoutBlock + LAYOUT.RowGap, 0, makeReadout)

	for index, letter in ipairs({ "H", "S", "V" }) do
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = letter
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = letter

local function _makeSearchBox(parent, yPos)

-- Word-boundary match: start of label or after space/underscore. Query escaped against
-- Luau pattern specials so chars like `(`, `.`, `%`, `[`, `*` match literally.
local function _escapePattern(s) return (s:gsub("[%(%)%.%%%+%-%*%?%[%]%^%$]", "%%%1")) end
local function _labelMatches(label, q)
	local esc = _escapePattern(q)
	return label:sub(1, #q) == q or label:find("[%s_]" .. esc) ~= nil
end

-- Wire search filtering on a scroll frame (call after building toggles).
-- External code (selection-filter, type-toggles) calls
-- `ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)` when it changes visibility while
-- a search is active. The next clear-search re-snapshots from post-filter state
-- instead of restoring stale pre-filter visibility (which would undo the filter).
function ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)
	if searchBox then searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", true) end
end

function ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scrollFrame)
	if not searchBox or not scrollFrame then return end
	local _saved = {} -- {[frame] = wasVisible} snapshot before search (bodies + rows)
	searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		local query = searchBox.Text:lower()
		local isSearch = query ~= ""
		-- If external code (filter toggle) marked the snapshot dirty, drop it and
		-- re-snapshot from current state. Otherwise clearing search would restore
		-- stale pre-filter visibility and undo the filter's just-applied changes.
		if searchBox:GetAttribute("_savedDirty") then
			_saved = {}
			searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", nil)
		end
		-- Save state on first search (bodies + rows from selection filter)
		if isSearch and next(_saved) == nil then
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Body" or d:GetAttribute("PropRow") or d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then _saved[d] = d.Visible end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then _saved[s] = s.Visible end end
		end
		if isSearch then
			local hits = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and d:GetAttribute("PropRow") then
					local lbl = d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
					if lbl then
						local match = _saved[d] and _labelMatches(lbl.Text:lower(), query)
						d.Visible = match or false
						if match then local c = d.Parent; while c and c ~= scrollFrame do hits[c] = true; c = c.Parent end end
					end
				end
			end
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then d.Visible = hits[d] or false
				elseif d.Name == "Body" and d:IsA("Frame") then d.Visible = hits[d] or false end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then s.Visible = hits[s] or false end end
		else
			for d, vis in pairs(_saved) do d.Visible = vis end; _saved = {}
		end
		-- Sync arrows
		for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
			local hdr = d:IsA("Frame") and d:FindFirstChild("Header")
			if hdr then local ar = hdr:FindFirstChild("Arrow"); if ar then
				local body = d:FindFirstChild("Body"); if body then ar.Text = body.Visible and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}" end
			end end
		end
	end)
end

-- Value types the Shifter can scale (QOL.shiftItems dispatches on typeof). Booleans, enums,
-- strings, colours and events never reach the Shifter list.
local SHIFTABLE_TYPES = { number = true, NumberRange = true, NumberSequence = true, Vector2 = true, Vector3 = true, UDim2 = true }
-- Item-level emit timing has no TypeData entry; QOL shifts the item attributes directly.
local SHIFTABLE_ITEM_ATTRS = { EmitCount = true, EmitDelay = true, EmitDuration = true }

-- Type-name + ctx-field-key constants live in PropertyCatalog (single source of truth).
-- ToolPanels reads via the local alias below; ClipShiftFix reads via
-- `ToolPanels.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS` which we re-expose for backwards compat.
local TYPE_ITEM_KEYS = PropertyCatalog.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS

-- Forwarding shim: body lives in `Modules/PropertyCatalog`. Same return shape.
local function _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn)
	return PropertyCatalog.merge(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn)
end

-- Cached maps (populated during build, accessed by ClipShiftFix via ToolPanels.propTypeMap)
ToolPanels.propTypeMap = {}; ToolPanels.propTypeMapShifter = {}; ToolPanels.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS = TYPE_ITEM_KEYS

-- Fills the Clipboard list with the union of every type's categories plus PE, and wires its search.
function ToolPanels.fillClipboardList(scroll, searchBox, TypeRegistry)
	local merged, propTypeMap = _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, PE_SECTIONS)
	ToolPanels.propTypeMap = propTypeMap
	W.buildPropToggles(scroll, merged, "Properties", 0, DISPLAY_NAMES)
	ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scroll)
end

-- Fills the Shifter list: props whose TypeData type is shiftable (SHIFTABLE_TYPES) plus the
-- item-level emit timing attrs; PE rows come from the curated PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER list.
function ToolPanels.fillShifterList(scroll, searchBox, TypeRegistry)
	local function shiftable(typeName, prop)
		if typeName == "PE" or SHIFTABLE_ITEM_ATTRS[prop] then return true end
		local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
		local def = typeDef and typeDef.properties and typeDef.properties[prop]
		return def ~= nil and SHIFTABLE_TYPES[def.type] == true
	end
	local merged, propTypeMap = _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER, nil, shiftable)
	ToolPanels.propTypeMapShifter = propTypeMap
	W.buildPropToggles(scroll, merged, "Properties", 0, DISPLAY_NAMES)
	ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scroll)
end

-- HUE CHANGER
-- =========================================================
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HANDLE_H = 8

-- The handle lands exactly on the neutral value within this many screen pixels of it.
local SNAP_PIXELS = 5

-- Builds a vertical slider with a gradient background.
-- xScale: 0-1 horizontal position (Scale-based for responsive layout).
-- trackHeightTrim / trackTop: how much shorter than `parent` the track is, and where it starts.
-- step: values are whole multiples of it, so the readout and the applied value are the same.
-- Returns getVal, setVal, track, bindReadout(box, scale, suffix): the box then shows the value
-- times `scale` (a whole number, with `suffix`) and sets the slider from what is typed into it.
local function makeVSlider(parent, xScale, gradient, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, step)
	local track = Instance.new("Frame"); track.Name = "Track"; track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 1, -trackHeightTrim); track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	track.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, trackTop)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); track.Parent = parent
	local cr = Instance.new("UICorner"); cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4); cr.Parent = track
	local gr = Instance.new("UIGradient"); gr.Rotation = 90; gr.Parent = track
	gr.Color = gradient
	local handle = Instance.new("Frame"); handle.Name = "Handle"; handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
	handle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); handle.Size = UDim2.new(1,4,0,HANDLE_H)
	handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5); handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)
	-- White whatever the theme: a theme change must not repaint it as text-coloured.
	handle:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	handle.ZIndex = 3; handle.Parent = track
	local hc = Instance.new("UICorner"); hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,3); hc.Parent = handle
	local hs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); hs.Color = Color3.new(0,0,0); hs.Thickness = 1; hs.Parent = handle

	local current = defaultVal
	local dragging = false
	local showValue = nil
	local lowest, highest = math.min(minVal, maxVal), math.max(minVal, maxVal)

	local function setVal(value)
		current = math.clamp(math.round(value / step) * step, lowest, highest)
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, (current - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0)
		if showValue then
			showValue()
		end
	end
	local function getVal()
		return current
	end

	-- Sets the value from a screen height on the track.
	local function setFromMouse(mouseY)
		local height = track.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local share = math.clamp((mouseY - track.AbsolutePosition.Y) / height, 0, 1)
		local neutral = (defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
		if math.abs(share - neutral) * height <= SNAP_PIXELS then
			share = neutral
		end
		setVal(minVal + share * (maxVal - minVal))
	end

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; btn.Text = ""
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); btn.ZIndex = 4; btn.Parent = track
	btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
		end
	end)
	btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
	local connections = W.getUISConnections()
	table.insert(connections, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			setFromMouse(input.Position.Y)
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))
	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		setFromMouse(UIS:GetMouseLocation().Y)
	end)

	local function bindReadout(box, scale, suffix)
		showValue = function()
			local shown = math.round(current * scale)
			box.Text = (shown == 0 and "0" or string.format("%+d", shown)) .. suffix
		end
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			-- Whatever is not part of a number goes: the suffix, a plus sign, spaces.
			local typed = tonumber((string.gsub(box.Text, "[^%d%.%-]", "")))
			if typed then
				setVal(typed / scale)
			else
				showValue()
			end
		end)
		showValue()
	end

	setVal(defaultVal)
	return getVal, setVal, track, bindReadout
end

-- Rainbow gradient for Hue
local hueGrad = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.167, Color3.fromHSV(0.167,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.333, Color3.fromHSV(0.333,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHSV(0.5,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.667, Color3.fromHSV(0.667,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.833, Color3.fromHSV(0.833,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)),
})
-- Saturation: white → full color (red as reference)
local satGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1))})
-- Value: white → black
local valGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0,0,0))})

-- The Hue, Saturation and Value sliders, with their get / set functions written into refs.
-- Hue moves in whole degrees, saturation and value in whole percent; under each track the
-- layout's makeReadout(index, xScale) -> TextBox shows the value and takes a typed one.
-- Classic tracks start 26 below the panel top and stop above the labels, readouts and buttons.
function ToolPanels.buildHueSliders(parent, refs, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, makeReadout)
	local sliders = {
		{ name = "Hue", gradient = hueGrad, min = -0.5, max = 0.5, step = 1 / 360, scale = 360, suffix = "\u{00B0}" },
		{ name = "Sat", gradient = satGrad, min = -1, max = 1, step = 0.01, scale = 100, suffix = "%" },
		{ name = "Val", gradient = valGrad, min = 1, max = -1, step = 0.01, scale = 100, suffix = "%" },
	}
	for index, slider in ipairs(sliders) do
		local xScale = (index * 2 - 1) / 6
		local getVal, setVal, _, bindReadout = makeVSlider(parent, xScale, slider.gradient, slider.min, slider.max, 0, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, slider.step)
		refs[slider.name .. "GetVal"] = getVal
		refs[slider.name .. "SetVal"] = setVal
		bindReadout(makeReadout(index, xScale), slider.scale, slider.suffix)
	end
end

--[[
	ToolShell  -  the frame of a floating tool panel: fixed size, resizable from its edges, with a
	header carrying the title, minimize (folds the panel into the HUD tray) and close.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared W table and adds:
	  W.makeToolPanel(sg, name, width, height) -> panel
	      The original shell: a boxed 18 px header inside the panel padding, content placed by
	      absolute offsets from y = 22. Classic builds every tool with it; a panel whose content
	      has no layout for the other modes uses it there too.
	  W.makeToolShell(sg, name, width, height) -> panel, chrome
	      The current mode's shell (Classic: makeToolPanel).
	  W.toolChrome(panel) -> chrome of a panel made by either call:
	      header           frame holding the title and the header buttons
	      title            the title label
	      close, minimize  the two built-in buttons
	      body             parent for content: the panel in the original shell, else a frame below the title bar
	      bodyTop          y inside body where content starts (22 in the original shell, else 0)
	      controlsWidth    width the buttons at the header's right take; grows with addButton
	      addButton(name, text, onClick) -> button placed left of the header buttons already there
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local BuildPacer = require(script.Parent.BuildPacer)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Original shell geometry.
local CLASSIC_BODY_TOP = 22
local CLASSIC_CONTROLS = 30
local CLASSIC_BUTTON = 18

return function(W)
	local addCorner, addStroke, addPadding = W.addCorner, W.addStroke, W.addPadding

	-- Panel -> chrome. Weak keys: a destroyed panel drops its entry.
	local chromeOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	function W.toolChrome(panel)
		return chromeOf[panel]
	end

	function W.makeToolPanel(sg, name, w, h)
		BuildPacer.step()
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = name.."Panel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,w,0,h); panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true; panel.Visible = false; panel.Parent = sg
		addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); addStroke(panel); addPadding(panel,5,5,5,5)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		local hd = W.makeBlob("Hd", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,18)); hd.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); hd.ZIndex = 10
		local t = Instance.new("TextLabel"); t.BackgroundTransparency = 1; t.Text = name
		t.TextColor3 = T.Gold; t.Font = T.Font; t.TextSize = 10; t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		t.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0); t.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); t.Parent = hd
		local cb = Instance.new("TextButton"); cb.Name = "Close"; cb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cb.Text = "X"; cb.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; cb.Font = T.Font; cb.TextSize = 9
		cb.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,1,0); cb.Position = UDim2.new(1,-14,0,0); cb.ZIndex = 12; cb.Parent = hd
		cb.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false end)
		-- Minimize folds the panel into the HUD tray (WidgetDeck.collapsePanel); its chip brings it back.
		local mb = Instance.new("TextButton"); mb.Name = "Min"; mb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		mb.Text = "\u{2013}"; mb.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; mb.Font = T.Font; mb.TextSize = 9
		mb.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,1,0); mb.Position = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,0); mb.ZIndex = 12; mb.Parent = hd
		mb.Activated:Connect(function() if W.collapsePanel then W.collapsePanel(panel) end end)
		panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", name)
		local dg = Instance.new("TextButton"); dg.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dg.Text = ""
		dg.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0); dg.ZIndex = 11; dg.Parent = hd; W.makeDraggable(panel, dg)
		W.makeResizable(panel, math.max(w, 80), 40)

		local chrome = {
			header = hd, title = t, close = cb, minimize = mb,
			body = panel, bodyTop = CLASSIC_BODY_TOP, controlsWidth = CLASSIC_CONTROLS,
		}
		function chrome.addButton(buttonName, text, onClick)
			local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
			button.Name = buttonName
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			button.Text = text
			button.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
			button.Font = T.Font
			button.TextSize = 7
			button.Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASSIC_BUTTON, 1, 0)
			button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(chrome.controlsWidth + CLASSIC_BUTTON), 0, 0)
			button.ZIndex = 12
			button.Parent = hd
			button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
			table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, function()
				button.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
			end)
			chrome.controlsWidth += CLASSIC_BUTTON
			return button
		end
		chromeOf[panel] = chrome
		return panel
	end

	-- Shell for the modes other than Classic: full-width title bar, content in a body frame under it.
	local function makeModernShell(sg, name, width, height)
		BuildPacer.step()
		local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
		local slot = LAYOUT.IconSlot

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = name .. "Panel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
		panel.ClipsDescendants = true
		panel.Active = true
		panel.Visible = false
		panel.Parent = sg
		addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner)
		addStroke(panel)
		addPadding(panel, pad, pad, pad, pad)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", name)

		local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, name, 0)
		bar.header.Name = "Hd"
		TypeScale.style(bar.title, "Group")
		bar.title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -slot * 2, 1, 0)
		bar.close.Activated:Connect(function()
			panel.Visible = false
		end)
		W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)

		-- Minimize folds the panel into the HUD tray (WidgetDeck.collapsePanel); its chip brings it back.
		local minimize = Instance.new("TextButton")
		minimize.Name = "Min"
		minimize.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		minimize.Text = "\u{2013}"
		minimize.Size = UDim2.new(0, slot, 1, 0)
		minimize.Position = UDim2.new(1, -slot * 2, 0, 0)
		minimize.ZIndex = 3
		TypeScale.style(minimize, "Glyph")
		W.paint(minimize, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		minimize.Parent = bar.header
		minimize.Activated:Connect(function()
			if W.collapsePanel then
				W.collapsePanel(panel)
			end
		end)

		-- One panel padding below the title bar, which itself starts in the padding above the content area.
		local body = Instance.new("Frame")
		body.Name = "ToolBody"
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar)
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -LAYOUT.TitleBar)
		body.Parent = panel

		W.makeResizable(panel, math.max(width, 80), LAYOUT.TitleBar + pad)

		local chrome = {
			header = bar.header, title = bar.title, close = bar.close, minimize = minimize,
			body = body, bodyTop = 0, controlsWidth = slot * 2,
		}
		function chrome.addButton(buttonName, text, onClick)
			local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
			button.Name = buttonName
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			button.Text = text
			button.Size = UDim2.new(0, slot, 1, 0)
			button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(chrome.controlsWidth + slot), 0, 0)
			button.ZIndex = 3
			TypeScale.style(button, "Caption")
			W.paint(button, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
			button.Parent = bar.header
			button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
			chrome.controlsWidth += slot
			return button
		end
		chromeOf[panel] = chrome
		return panel
	end

	function W.makeToolShell(sg, name, width, height)
		local panel
		if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, name, width, height)
		else
			panel = makeModernShell(sg, name, width, height)
		end
		return panel, chromeOf[panel]
	end
end
